cause_attribution: Charge an erroneous label once to the first applicable definition/application cause; later causes count additional distinct labels only.

For older omissions, assign resource/circuit/advice endpoints first; then counting/quantum endpoints; then the basic-classical block. Internal-counting and other counting interfaces are disjoint subgroups.
Recent quantum/SZK allowances are incremental after the recent classical allowance. Do not add both reviewers' earlier recent totals.
Software/assembly covers additional errors after mathematical and historical causes.
Each event means at least one error in its whole family. Its impact is the union of affected pairs over all such errors, not a per-paper multiplier. No independence of events or reviews is assumed.
residual_error_assessment.aggregation_caution: Source reviewers' unconditional estimates are approximations to the stated incremental counts. Remaining overlap would conservatively overcount; the ledger is an explicit judgment, not a fitted statistical model.

stopping_decision.decision: Stop this audit pass and publish the revisable benchmark. No concrete remaining incorrect label is known.

limitations: All pairs are indexed through domain and theorem-family reviews, not2500 independent literature searches.
Negative searches do not prove openness; no statistical omission-detection rate is known.
The full scholarly literature, every journal or language, and unpublished arguments were not exhaustively searched.
SAT concerns only the finite encoded theory; Lean inference traces assume cited mathematical premises.
Operational textbook-equivalence and deep literature proofs remain trusted inputs; the user waived re-formalizing existing proofs.
Historical eligibility admits a question, not a model answer. Proof and run-integrity review remain required.
An overlooked accepted pre-cutoff result earns zero and triggers a recorded correction and any versioned rescore.
